elena (support): heads up — customers running our python sdk v0.9.1 on k8s are seeing repeated 503s. workers retry at the same cadence and we get a big spike. looks like jitter is effectively constant across coroutines.
ryan (eng-runtime): can you paste the minimal repro? sdk version + how many parallel coroutines/threads?
elena (support): here's the simplified repro we used (asyncio):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import asyncio
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=... , timeout=10)
async def fire(n):
    for i in range(n):
        await client.chat.create(model="redwood-alpha", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
async def main():
    await asyncio.gather(*(fire(50) for _ in range(8)))
asyncio.run(main())
```
Running ~400 concurrent requests per pod.
todd (devx): do you see identical backoff intervals in the logs? try REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug and grep for backoff_jitter values.
elena (support): i attached a short log snippet: backoff_jitter=0.124, backoff_jitter=0.124, backoff_jitter=0.124 ... repeated across requests and processes.
ryan (eng-runtime): reproduced locally with same setup. root cause looks like the backoff module seeds python's random once at import with a constant when env var not set. code roughly: `random.seed(int(os.getenv("REDWOOD_BACKOFF_JITTER_SEED", 42)))` — that makes jitter deterministic and identical across greenlets/threads in a process and across containers if they start with same seed.
ryan (eng-runtime): quick repro log: `backoff_base=0.5 backoff_jitter=0.124 retry_after=...` for every retry across concurrent tasks.
ryan (eng-runtime): workaround: set REDWOOD_BACKOFF_JITTER_SEED=auto (or remove the seed) or upgrade to the patched wheel. patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/198 (seed initialization removed; uses secrets.token_bytes to seed per-instance jitter).
ryan (eng-runtime): immediate workaround without changing code: export REDWOOD_BACKOFF_JITTER_SEED= (empty) OR export REDWOOD_BACKOFF_JITTER_SEED=auto
retry-bot: Created ticket INC-4532 for customer escalation (priority: high).
infra-bot: Noted — autoscaler bumped replicas to spread load.
elena (support): thanks — any ETA on a release? customer is seeing production impact. :pray:
ryan (eng-runtime): we'll cut a 0.9.2 hotfix within 24h. if you need a faster unblock pip install git+https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk@fix/backoff-jitter#egg=redwood-sdk or set env var as above. i'll follow up with a changelog and test matrix.
elena (support): confirmed workaround reduces synchronized retries for now. keeping INC-4532 updated.
